{
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim_id": "ISS_001",
      "claim_text": "A source passage that either distinguishes RNase H and flap endonuclease activities in eukaryotic lagging-strand primer removal, or unambiguously assigns primer removal to one named activity without equating them.",
      "entailment_status": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "biological_scope": "Eukaryotic nuclear DNA replication, lagging strand, primer removal step; organisms: general eukaryotes (e.g., Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Homo sapiens) as model systems.",
      "support": [],
      "reason": "The only provided source (E_4f6c1622d538) is about vinculin-raver1 interactions and mRNA localization at focal adhesions. It contains no passages about DNA replication, RNA primers, RNase H, or flap endonuclease."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "ISS_002",
      "claim_text": "A source passage stating that DNA polymerase alpha hands off specifically to DNA polymerase delta on the lagging strand (as opposed to a generic 'second polymerase').",
      "entailment_status": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "biological_scope": "Eukaryotic DNA replication, lagging strand synthesis; polymerase switching from pol alpha to pol delta.",
      "support": [],
      "reason": "The provided source is a structural biology paper on vinculin and raver1; it does not discuss DNA polymerases, lagging-strand synthesis, or polymerase switching."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "ISS_003",
      "claim_text": "Either (a) a represented replacement-synthesis step (or explicit gap-filling product state) that produces the DNA-replaced, nicked substrate for ligation, or (b) a source statement that ligation can act on the gap state left after primer removal without a separate replacement step.",
      "entailment_status": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "biological_scope": "Eukaryotic lagging-strand maturation: primer removal, gap filling/replacement synthesis, and ligation.",
      "support": [],
      "reason": "The provided source does not address Okazaki fragment maturation, primer removal, replacement synthesis, nicks, gaps, or DNA ligase in the context of eukaryotic DNA replication."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "ISS_004",
      "claim_text": "A modeled displaced-primer state (e.g., primer RNA annealed to template vs. displaced single-stranded flap) that links the displacement event in POL_DELTA_EXTENSION to the removal target in PRIMER_REMOVAL.",
      "entailment_status": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "biological_scope": "Eukaryotic lagging-strand replication: pol delta strand displacement and primer flap formation.",
      "support": [],
      "reason": "The provided source contains no content on DNA polymerase delta, strand displacement, RNA primer flaps, or Okazaki fragment processing."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "STATE_MODEL_MIGRATION",
      "claim_text": "Identify supported pre-clip conditions, explicit subject/property/value states and missing state producers without omitting user-required mechanisms. Preserve actual user teaching scope.",
      "entailment_status": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "biological_scope": "Eukaryotic DNA replication local events: priming by pol alpha-primase, extension by pol alpha then pol delta, primer removal (RNase H/flap endonuclease), and ligation; excludes origin licensing/firing.",
      "support": [],
      "reason": "The provided source is unrelated to the requested state model for eukaryotic DNA replication priming, extension, primer removal, and ligation; it addresses focal adhesion protein interactions and mRNA localization. No relevant states or mechanisms are described."
    }
  ],
  "decision": "FAIL"
}
